working.entered_source:
1 CLEAR 200,53247
5 SCREEN 0:WIDTH 40
10 N=0:S=1
20 CLS:PRINT "TURN";N
25 FOR J=0 TO 959:POKE 53248+J,VPEEK(J):NEXT J
30 INPUT A$
35 IF A$="Q" THEN END
40 GOSUB 1000
50 GOTO 20
1000 C=0
1010 IF A$<>"GO" THEN RETURN
1020 N=N+S
1030 IF N>255 THEN N=N-256
1040 C=1
1050 RETURN
RUN
